name: com.inspetor.InspetorProvider
description: Inspetor (antifraud event SDK) prepares app context at process startup so the app can later send account, sign-in, sale, password recovery, and page activity for risk monitoring. This provider does not perform those app actions itself.
disableEffect: Inspetor event reporting will not be prepared automatically; the app's own sign-in and purchase screens are separate.
